name: Pedololisu
source:
An individual working for the Maya Union; a former assassination target with the priority number of 69.
His hobby is raping women but it seems despite his name he's neither a pedo nor a lolicon.
[spoiler]He was blown away by Mezaroa who killed him using his own move "tsukiyubi" (突指), but it's not fully known whether he isn't still alive somehow (probably not).[/spoiler]
